secondary zone: The secondary zone copies records from the primary DNS server.
辅助区域会从主 DNS 服务器复制记录。
primary zone: Only the primary zone accepts changes to our hospital domain names.
只有主要区域才接受本院域名的修改。
AD-integrated zone: Our AD-integrated zone stores DNS data inside Active Directory.
我们的目录集成区域把 DNS 数据存在 Active Directory 里。
scavenging: Scavenging removed stale address records from the ward DNS zone last night.
过期记录清理昨晚从病区 DNS 区域删掉了过时的地址记录。
aging: Aging marks old host records so they can be removed later.
记录老化会标出旧的主机记录，方便以后删除。
dynamic update: A dynamic update registered the new clinic computer in DNS this morning.
今天早上，一次动态更新把新的门诊电脑登记进了 DNS。
secure update: A secure update requires the computer to prove its domain identity first.
安全更新要求电脑先证明自己的域身份。
zone transfer: The zone transfer failed when the secondary server rejected the request.
辅助服务器拒绝了请求，区域传送因此失败。
AXFR: Last night's AXFR (Authoritative Zone Transfer) copied every record to the spare server.
昨晚的 AXFR（全量区域传送）把全部记录复制到了备用服务器。
IXFR: The IXFR (Incremental Zone Transfer) sent only the records changed since Tuesday.
IXFR（增量区域传送）只发送了周二以来变更过的记录。
DNS notify: DNS notify told the secondary server that the zone had changed.
区域变更通知告诉辅助服务器，该区域已经变了。
TSIG: TSIG (Transaction Signature) signs each transfer so a stranger cannot alter it.
TSIG（事务签名）给每次传送签名，防止外人篡改。
DNSSEC: DNSSEC (Domain Name System Security Extensions) proves our hospital domain records are genuine.
DNSSEC（域名安全扩展）用来证明本院域名记录是真实的。
RRSIG: Each RRSIG (Resource Record Signature) covers one set of host records.
每条 RRSIG（资源记录签名）覆盖一组主机记录。
DS record: The DS record in the parent zone links to our hospital signing key.
父区域里的委托签名记录指向本院的签名密钥。
glue record: A glue record supplies the address of the name server itself.
粘合记录提供的是域名服务器自身的地址。
root hints: Root hints tell our DNS server where the internet root servers are.
根提示告诉 DNS 服务器，互联网根服务器在哪里。
forwarder: The forwarder sends unknown names to the city's DNS service.
转发器会把解析不了的名字交给市里的 DNS。
recursion: Recursion lets our DNS server chase the answer for the user.
递归查询让 DNS 服务器替用户把答案查到底。
iterative query: An iterative query returns the next server, not the final address.
迭代查询返回的是下一台服务器，不是最终地址。
cache poisoning: Cache poisoning placed a fake pharmacy address into our DNS cache.
缓存投毒把一个假的药房地址写进了我们的 DNS 缓存。
DNS tunneling: DNS tunneling can smuggle data out inside ordinary name lookups.
域名隧道能把数据藏在普通的域名查询里传出去。
DoH: DoH (DNS over HTTPS) sends name lookups through the same path as web pages.
DoH（加密域名查询）走和网页相同的路径发送域名查询。
DoT: DoT (DNS over TLS) encrypts lookups between the wards and our resolver.
DoT（加密域名传输）会加密病区与解析器之间的查询。
split DNS: Split DNS gives staff an internal address and guests a public one.
内外域名分离给员工内网地址，给访客公网地址。
internal zone: The internal zone holds names that only hospital staff should resolve.
内网区域存放只有本院员工才应该解析到的名字。
external zone: The external zone publishes the public website and the mail host.
外网区域对外发布网站和邮件主机的名字。
reverse zone: The reverse zone maps printer addresses back to their host names.
反向区域把打印机地址反查成主机名。
PTR: The PTR (Pointer Record) for that printer says it belongs to Pharmacy.
那台打印机的 PTR（反向解析记录）表明它属于药剂科。
SOA: The SOA (Start of Authority) shows the contact for our hospital zone.
SOA（起始授权记录）写明本院 DNS 区域的联系人。
NS record: The NS record lists which servers answer for the clinic domain.
域名服务器记录列出负责门诊域名的服务器。
TXT record: A TXT record on our domain holds the mail security policy.
我们域名上的一条文本记录存着邮件安全策略。
SPF: SPF (Sender Policy Framework) lists which servers may send hospital mail.
SPF（发件人策略）列出可以发送本院邮件的服务器。
DKIM: DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) signs outbound messages so recipients can trust them.
DKIM（邮件签名）为外发邮件签名，方便对方核验。
DMARC: DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance) tells recipients how to treat failed mail checks.
DMARC（邮件认证报告）告诉收件方如何处理未通过核验的邮件。
MX failover: MX failover moved inbound mail to the spare host during the outage.
故障期间，邮件交换切换把入站邮件转到了备用主机。
smarthost: The smarthost relays clinic mail through the city's approved gateway.
智能中继通过市里批准的网关转发门诊邮件。
relay: Our relay refuses mail that does not come from a hospital system.
我们的邮件中继会拒收非医院系统发来的邮件。
open relay: An open relay would let strangers send spam from our hospital address.
开放中继会让陌生人借用本院地址发送垃圾邮件。
spam score: The spam score on that pharmacy notice was high enough to quarantine it.
那封药剂科通知的垃圾评分高到被隔离了。
quarantine mailbox: I found the missing invoice inside the quarantine mailbox this morning.
我今天早上在隔离邮箱里找到了那张不见的发票。
NDR: The NDR (Non-Delivery Report) said the ward clerk's mailbox was full.
NDR（未送达报告）说病区文员的邮箱已经满了。
DSN: A DSN (Delivery Status Notification) confirmed the lab report reached Pathology.
DSN（投递状态通知）确认检验报告已经送到病理科。
mailbox database: The mailbox database for nursing grew quickly after the new ward opened.
新病区启用后，护理部的邮箱数据库涨得很快。
mailbox quota: Her mailbox quota is full, so the shift roster bounced back.
她的邮箱配额满了，排班表因此被退了回来。
archive mailbox: Older messages move into her archive mailbox when the main box fills.
主邮箱一满，较旧的邮件就会进到她的归档邮箱。
litigation hold: Litigation hold keeps every message in that mailbox until the case ends.
在案件结束前，诉讼保留会留下该邮箱的每一封邮件。
in-place hold: An in-place hold preserves deleted mail without moving it elsewhere.
就地保留会留下已删除的邮件，而不把它挪到别处。
eDiscovery: Legal asked eDiscovery to search the director's mail for the contract thread.
法务请电子取证在主任邮箱里查找合同那串邮件。
journaling: Journaling copies every outbound message into the compliance mailbox.
邮件日志会把每封外发邮件复制进合规邮箱。
transport rule: A transport rule adds a confidentiality line to mail leaving the hospital.
有一条传输规则会给离院邮件加上保密提示。
mail flow: Mail flow between the lab and the wards slowed down after noon.
过了中午，检验科和病区之间的邮件流就变慢了。
connector: This connector carries mail between the hospital and the city health bureau.
这个连接器负责本院和市卫健委之间的邮件往来。
send connector: The send connector for the bureau uses the city mail gateway.
发往卫健委的发送连接器走市里的邮件网关。
receive connector: The receive connector allows mail only from the laboratory subnet.
接收连接器只接收检验子网发来的邮件。
accepted domain: The accepted domain list now includes the new clinic email suffix.
接受域名清单里现在有了新门诊的邮箱后缀。
authoritative domain: Our authoritative domain covers every staff address at the hospital.
我们的权威域名覆盖本院每一个员工邮箱地址。
internal relay domain: The internal relay domain accepts partner mail and passes it on.
内部中继域名收下合作方邮件，再继续往下投。
autodiscover: Autodiscover filled in the server name when she set up her mail.
她配置邮箱时，自动发现已经填好了服务器名。
Outlook profile: Her Outlook profile still points at the old ward mailbox.
她的邮件配置文件还指着旧的病区邮箱。
OST: The OST (Offline Storage Table) lets her read mail when the ward network drops.
病区断网时，OST（脱机数据文件）仍能让她读邮件。
PST: He saved the old director's mail into a PST (Personal Storage Table) file.
他把前任主任的邮件存成了一个 PST（个人存储文件）。
cached mode: Cached mode kept her mail available during the ward network drop.
病区断网那段时间，缓存模式让她的邮件还能看。
online mode: Online mode needs a live connection, which the basement clinic often lacks.
在线模式必须实时连着，而地下门诊经常做不到。
mailbox move: The mailbox move to the new server finishes after the evening report.
迁到新服务器的邮箱迁移会在晚交班之后完成。
hybrid mail: Hybrid mail keeps some boxes on site and the rest in the cloud.
混合邮件把一部分邮箱留在院内，其余放在云上。
exchange: Our exchange still delivers ward rosters every morning at six.
我们的邮件系统仍会在每天早上六点送出病区排班表。
calendar free-busy: Check her calendar free-busy before you propose a Thursday meeting.
提议周四开会之前，先看一下她的忙闲状态。
agenda: The agenda starts with discharges and ends with staffing gaps.
议程先谈出院，最后谈人手缺口。
follow-up: The follow-up with that family is booked for Friday morning.
和那户家属的跟进约在周五上午。
handover: A clear handover saves the night team from guessing what changed.
交接写清楚，夜班就不用猜白天发生了什么。
deadline: The deadline for comments on the policy is Thursday at noon.
对这份制度提意见的截止日期是周四中午。
briefing: The briefing for new clerks covers badges, phones, and confidentiality.
新文员的简报会讲工牌、电话和保密要求。
clarify: Could you clarify which cost center should pay for this courier?
你能澄清一下这笔快递该由哪个成本中心付吗？
postpone: We may postpone the workshop if the survey runs long.
如果现场评审拖长，研讨会可能会推迟。
minutes: The minutes should name the decision and who will carry it out.
会议纪要要写明决定，以及由谁去落实。
owner: The owner of the visitor process is the front desk supervisor.
访客流程的负责人是前台主管。
update: An update on the lift repair will come at three.
电梯维修的更新会在三点送来。
attendee: One attendee from each ward is enough for this briefing.
这次简报每个病区来一位参会人就够了。
quorum: We had a quorum once Pharmacy and Nursing both sat down.
药剂科和护理部都坐下之后，法定人数就够了。
adjourn: The chairperson may adjourn early if we lose the quorum.
如果不够法定人数，主持人可以提前休会。
chairperson: Ask the chairperson before you add a late item to the agenda.
想在议程里临时加一项，先问过主持人。
facilitator: The facilitator stopped the side argument and returned to the agenda.
引导人打断了岔开的争论，把大家拉回议程。
kickoff: The kickoff will introduce the sponsor, the scope, and the timeline.
启动会会介绍发起人、范围和时间线。
wrap-up: Leave time at the end for a short wrap-up.
结尾留一点时间做个简短收尾。
recap: His recap of the ops meeting fitted onto half a page.
他把运营会的回顾摘要压进了半页纸。
takeaway: The takeaway for clerks is to confirm the room twice.
给文员的会议要点是：会议室要确认两遍。
action item: This action item is to refresh the extension list by Friday.
这条待办事项是在周五前更新分机号码表。
talking point: A talking point for Monday is the long queue at registration.
周一的一个讨论要点是挂号处排长队。
parking lot: Salary questions went to the parking lot so we could finish on time.
薪资问题放进了待议事项，会议才能准时结束。
workshop: The workshop on difficult conversations is limited to sixteen people.
关于难谈话的研讨会限十六人参加。
offsite: Please keep phones away during the afternoon session of the offsite.
外出研讨的下午场，请把手机收起来。
town hall: Staff may submit questions for the town hall by Wednesday.
员工可以在周三前提交想在全员大会上问的问题。
webinar: I will join the webinar from the huddle room so the office stays quiet.
我到小讨论室参加网络研讨会，免得办公室不安静。
conference call: The conference call dropped once, and we dialed straight back.
电话会议中断了一次，我们马上又拨了回去。
dial-in: The dial-in is printed on the invitation, just under the link.
拨入号印在邀请上，就在链接下面。
mute: Please mute the speaker when you walk past the open wards.
经过敞开的病区时，请把免提静音。
unmute: Unmute one person at a time so each speaker can be heard.
一次只取消一个人的静音，这样发言的人才能被听清。
screen share: Screen share is enough, and we can skip the printed slides.
有屏幕共享就够了，幻灯片不用再印。
timeslot: Is there a timeslot on Tuesday that avoids the bed meeting?
周二有没有一个错开床位会的时间段？
RSVP: Please send your RSVP (please reply) for the town hall before Friday.
请在周五前回复是否出席全员大会。
calendar: My calendar is clear after three, apart from a short catch-up.
我的日历三点以后空着，只剩一个短的补会。
invitation: The invitation names the training room and asks people to arrive early.
邀请上写了培训室，并请大家早点到。
decline: I have to decline Thursday because I am covering the switchboard.
周四我得拒绝，因为我要顶总机。
accept: I will accept the interview slot if it stays after four.
如果面试还定在四点以后，我就接受。
tentative: Ten o'clock is only a tentative time for the interview.
十点只是这次面试的暂定时间。
availability: Share your availability for the skip-level sometime next week.
把你下周越级沟通的可出席时间发一下。
reschedule: We should reschedule the walkthrough because the ward is closed to visitors.
病区不让探视，现场走查得改期。
cancel: They will cancel the brown-bag if fewer than six people reply.
如果回复不到六人，午餐分享会就会取消。
confirm: Can you confirm the interpreter before we promise the family?
答应家属之前，你能先确认翻译在吗？
reminder: The reminder about badges will go on the notice board today.
关于工牌的提醒今天会贴到公告栏上。
announcement: An announcement about the water shutdown is going out at noon.
停水通知中午会发出去。
memo: The memo asks us to stop leaving patient lists on the counter.
内部备忘要求我们不要把患者名单留在台面上。
notice: A notice by the lift explains the temporary way up to the wards.
电梯旁的通告说明了去病区的临时路线。
circular: Read the circular on gifts before a vendor offers you lunch.
供应商请吃饭之前，先看关于礼品的传阅文件。
newsletter: The newsletter this month tells the story behind one compliment.
这个月的简讯讲了一则表扬背后的事。
one-pager: The one-pager should show the problem, the options, and what we need.
一页摘要要写清问题、可选做法，以及我们需要什么。
slide deck: Cut the slide deck to eight slides for a twenty-minute slot.
只有二十分钟，幻灯片稿请压到八页。
appendix: The full roster sits in the appendix, after the short summary.
完整排班表在摘要后面的附录里。
summary: The summary leaves out names and keeps only the themes.
摘要不写姓名，只保留几类问题。
overview: This overview is for new clerks who have never worked a clinic desk.
这份概览是写给没站过门诊台的新文员的。
outline: The outline has three parts: purpose, steps, and exceptions.
提纲分三块：目的、步骤和例外。
proposal: Her proposal would add a clerk to the triage desk at peak time.
她的提案是在高峰时段给分诊台加一名文员。
pitch: Keep the pitch under ten minutes and leave room for questions.
方案陈述控制在十分钟内，留出提问时间。
quotation: That quotation excludes delivery to the individual wards.
那份报价不含送到各个病区的费用。
bid: Our bid promises delivery within the lead time the wards need.
我们的投标承诺在病区需要的供货周期内送到。
contract: The security contract is up for renewal in January.
保安合同一月份就要续签。
vendor: The vendor will train two clerks when the new printers arrive.
新打印机到了以后，供应商会培训两名文员。
procurement: Procurement will not treat a verbal quote as a commitment.
采购不把口头询价当成承诺。
invoice: The invoice number does not match the purchase order.
这张发票的号码和采购订单对不上。
reimbursement: Reimbursement was delayed because the hotel bill had no name.
报销被拖了，因为酒店账单上没有姓名。
itinerary: Check the itinerary again if the bureau changes the start time.
如果卫健委改了开始时间，再对一遍行程。
logistics: The logistics for the offsite include a bus and boxed lunches.
外出研讨的后勤安排包括一辆大巴和盒饭。
onboard: The buddy will onboard her at the lobby and walk her to the ward.
带教搭档会在大厅做入职对接，再送她去病区。
offboard: Remember to offboard him on Friday, including the badge and the locker.
记得周五给他做离职交接，工牌和储物柜都要收回。
probation: During probation she will have a check-in every two weeks.
试用期里她每两周有一次面谈。
appraisal: Bring examples of your work to the appraisal on Thursday.
周四绩效考核时，带上几件你做过的事。
overtime: Overtime after a full day shift should be agreed in advance.
上完白班再加班，应当事先说好。
shift: Which shift are you working on the public holiday?
公共假期你上哪个班次？
roster: The roster on the wall is older than the one in the email.
墙上的排班表比邮件里的那份旧。
coverage: We still need coverage at the information desk from twelve to one.
问询台十二点到一点的顶班安排还空着。
deputy: Please tell the deputy as well when the director is away.
主任不在时，也请告知代理人。
proxy: Name a proxy before you go on annual leave next week.
下周休年假之前，请指定一位授权代表。
delegate: I will delegate the newsletter draft to the intern this month.
这个月我把简讯草稿委派给实习生来写。
authorize: The manager must authorize any taxi home after ten at night.
晚上十点后打车回家，必须由经理授权。
headcount: The headcount request for a weekend clerk is with the director.
增加周末文员编制人数的申请在主任那里。
vacancy: The vacancy was advertised internally before we looked outside.
这个空缺岗位先在内部公布，然后才对外招。
interview: The interview panel includes the supervisor and a senior clerk.
面试小组里有主管和一位资深文员。
offer: She has until Friday to accept or decline the offer.
她最晚周五决定接受还是拒绝这份录用通知。
milestone: Signing the contract is the milestone we need before ordering.
签字合同是下单之前必须到达的里程碑。
deliverable: A one-page handover note is the deliverable for this task.
这项任务的交付物是一页纸的交接说明。
scope: Adding the night clinic would widen the scope of the project.
如果加上夜间门诊，项目范围就会变大。
stakeholder: The ward sister is a stakeholder in any change to visiting hours.
探视时间一改，护士长就是相关方。
sponsor: Our sponsor wants a monthly note, not a long slide deck.
发起人要的是每月一页说明，不是一长套幻灯片。
timeline: The timeline slips if the vendor misses the letterhead date.
供应商若误了抬头纸的日期，时间线就会往后滑。
backlog: The backlog of unsigned minutes goes back three meetings.
没签字的会议纪要已经积压了三次会议。
blocker: The missing seal is the blocker on sending the letter today.
信今天发不出去，阻塞项是缺了印章。
dependency: This task has a dependency on Legal finishing the contract.
这件事依赖法务先把合同看完。
risk: The risk we discussed is a full waiting list over the holiday.
我们说的风险是假期里等候名单会排满。
mitigation: Our mitigation is a second clerk at registration from eight to ten.
我们的缓解措施是八点到十点在挂号处再加一名文员。
contingency: The contingency is to hold clinic in the training room.
应急预案是把门诊改到培训室。
escalate: Escalate the lost-property complaint if it is still open tomorrow.
失物投诉如果明天还没了结，就升级上报。
bottleneck: Signing letters by hand has become a bottleneck for the secretary.
信要手签，已经成了秘书这边的瓶颈。
bandwidth: I don't have the bandwidth for another project this week.
我这周没有精力再接一个项目。
capacity: The front desk has no capacity to cover phones and the queue together.
前台没有同时接电话又维持排队的承载能力。
allocation: The allocation gives two clerks to clinic and one to the wards.
这次资源分配是门诊两名文员、病区一名。
estimate: My estimate is three days to rewrite the visitor procedure.
我的估算是，重写访客流程要三天。
KPI: On-time discharge is the KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for the bed meeting.
准时出院是床位会的 KPI（关键绩效指标）。
metric: The metric we watch daily is how long families wait for news.
我们每天看的衡量指标是家属等多久才有消息。
sign-off: We cannot print the new letterhead without a sign-off from Communications.
没有宣传部门的签字确认，新的公文抬头纸不能印。
approval: Capital approval for the lockers is still sitting with Finance.
储物柜的资金审批还在财务那里。
phase: We are in the phase of collecting comments, not rewriting yet.
我们现在处于收集意见的阶段，还没开始改写。
prioritize: Prioritize the families who have been waiting since early morning.
请把从一大早就在等的家属排出优先级。
negotiate: We can negotiate the delivery day, but not the safety clauses.
送货日期可以协商，安全条款不行。
compromise: The compromise was a nine-thirty start instead of nine o'clock.
折中的结果是九点半开始，而不是九点。
consensus: There is no consensus yet on whether interns should work nights.
实习生要不要上夜班，目前还没有共识。
feedback: Feedback from the night shift says the handover note is too long.
夜班的反馈是交接说明写得太长。
confidential: Please treat this family complaint as confidential and keep it in the office.
请把这封家属投诉当作保密件，只留在办公室里。
urgent: There is an urgent memo about the broken lift in Outpatients.
有一份紧急备忘，说的是门诊楼的电梯坏了。
template: Use the template so every incident report has the same headings.
请用模板，这样每份不良事件报告的栏目才一致。
checklist: Tick the checklist as you go, not from memory afterwards.
核对清单边做边勾，不要事后靠记忆补。
SOP: The SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) for lost badges starts with security.
工牌丢失的 SOP（标准作业程序）从保卫科开始。
policy: The policy forbids sharing passwords, even with your supervisor.
制度禁止共享密码，对上级主管也不行。
guideline: The guideline allows flex time as long as core hours are covered.
指引允许弹性工时，只要核心工时有人在。
procedure: The procedure for a sick call is on the first page of the roster.
病假来电的流程步骤写在排班表的第一页。
workflow: The workflow now asks registration to phone the clinic, not the patient.
工作流程现在要求挂号处打电话给门诊，而不是打给患者。
compliance: Compliance wants evidence that staff have read the privacy memo.
合规部门要看到员工已经读过保密备忘的证据。
audit: During the audit they may ask who holds the spare stamp.
审计时他们可能会问备用公章在谁手里。
archive: Archive the volunteer sign-in sheets once the year is closed.
这一年结束后，请把志愿者签到表归档。
revision: Please use revision three, because the visiting rules changed.
请用第三修订版，因为探视规定已经改了。
draft: This is only a draft, so please do not circulate it yet.
这还只是草稿，先不要传阅。
CC: Please CC (Carbon Copy) the ward sister when you write to a family.
给家属写信时，请 CC（抄送）护士长。
BCC: BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) the manager when the message concerns a complaint.
邮件涉及投诉时，请 BCC（密送）经理。
subject line: Put the patient initials, not the full name, in the subject line.
邮件主题里写患者姓名缩写，不要写全名。
attachment: The attachment is the scanned consent, named with the date.
附件是按日期命名的知情同意扫描件。
thread: Keep the salary discussion in a separate thread from the roster.
薪资讨论不要和排班表放在同一封邮件串里。
inbox: I clear the shared inbox at nine, at one, and at four.
共享收件箱我在九点、一点和四点各清一次。
FYI: FYI (For Your Information), the canteen is closed for cleaning on Friday.
FYI（仅供参考），食堂周五打扫，暂停开放。
EOD: I need your edits on the circular by EOD (End of Day) Thursday.
传阅文件的修改我需要在周四 EOD（下班前）收到。
ASAP: I need the signed roster back ASAP so the night team can plan.
签好的排班表请尽快还我，夜班才好安排。
reply-all: Please do not reply-all on a thread that names a patient.
邮件串里有患者姓名时，请不要全部回复。
forward: Forward the bureau reply to the liaison and to me.
请把卫健委的回信转发给联络人和我。
signature: Add your job title and extension number to the signature.
请在签名档里加上职务和分机号。
acknowledge: Did you acknowledge the memo about the new visitor rules?
关于新访客规定的备忘，你确认收到了吗？
align: We should align with the wards before publishing the new pathway.
新路径公布之前，我们要先和病区对齐共识。
sync: Can we sync this afternoon about the holiday coverage?
今天下午能同步沟通一下假期顶班吗？
catch-up: Our catch-up can be ten minutes after the board round.
看板交班之后，我们的补会沟通有十分钟就行。
ping: I will ping the secretary if the room is still unconfirmed at noon.
如果中午会议室还没定，我会快速提醒秘书。
nudge: Could you nudge the vendor about the missing quotation?
报价还没到，你能催一下供应商吗？
circulate: Circulate the holiday notice today so people can plan leave.
今天就把假期通知传阅出去，大家才好安排休假。
next steps: The next steps are a call to the family and a note in the log.
下一步是给家属打电话，并在日志里记一笔。
status update: The status update should say what changed since last Friday.
进展通报要写明上周五以来有什么变化。
weekly report: Keep the weekly report to one page plus the attendance table.
周报控制在一页，另附出席情况表。
monthly report: The monthly report compares this month's complaints with last month.
月报把这个月的投诉和上个月做了对比。
quarterly review: The quarterly review will ask why overtime rose in February.
季度回顾会问二月加班为什么上升。
annual review: Block a morning in November for the annual review of policies.
请在十一月留一个上午做制度的年度回顾。
performance review: Your performance review will cover the probation goals we set.
绩效面谈会对照我们定过的试用期目标。
project plan: The project plan puts staff training ahead of the first clinic day.
项目计划把员工培训排在门诊第一天之前。
work plan: The work plan for June includes the inventory and the fire drill.
六月的工作计划包括盘点和消防演练。
meeting invite: The meeting invite has the wrong room, so I will send a correction.
会议邀请上的房间写错了，我会再发更正。
calendar invite: Did the calendar invite reach the people on the late shift?
晚班的人收到日历邀请了吗？
standing meeting: The standing meeting is cancelled when the director is on leave.
主任休假时，这次例会取消。
ad hoc: We arranged an ad hoc briefing when the census suddenly rose.
在院人数突然上升时，我们安排了一次临时简报。
one-on-one: I use the one-on-one to hear what the roster is not showing.
我用一对一面谈来听排班表上看不出来的情况。
skip-level: The skip-level is a conversation, not a performance review.
越级沟通是谈话，不是绩效面谈。
all-hands: The all-hands will be shortened because clinic runs late on Fridays.
周五门诊结束得晚，全员会会缩短。
brown-bag: Bring your own lunch to the brown-bag on clearer writing.
关于把公文写清楚的午餐分享会，请自带午饭。
icebreaker: The icebreaker was simply to say your ward and your role.
破冰环节只是说一下自己的病区和岗位。
roundtable: At the roundtable, each ward had three minutes to speak.
圆桌讨论上，每个病区有三分钟发言。
brainstorm: The brainstorm produced more ideas than we can try this quarter.
这场头脑风暴出的主意，这个季度试不完。
whiteboard: Photograph the whiteboard before the cleaner wipes it tonight.
今晚保洁擦白板之前，先给白板上的字拍下来。
flipchart: We ran out of paper for the flipchart halfway through the workshop.
研讨会进行到一半，挂纸板的纸用完了。
handout: The handout has the extension list on the back page.
会发材料的背面是分机号码表。
attendance: Attendance was low because the invite went out yesterday afternoon.
邀请昨天下午才发出去，出席情况不太好。
regrets: Send your regrets early if clinic will keep you from the meeting.
如果门诊走不开，请尽早发来请假缺席。
latecomer: The latecomer slipped in during the second talking point.
迟到者是在第二个讨论要点时悄悄进来的。
timekeeper: The timekeeper gave a two-minute signal before each section ended.
每一段结束前，计时员会给一个还剩两分钟的信号。
scribe: If the scribe is absent, the chairperson should appoint another.
会议记录员缺席时，主持人应另指定一人。
ground rules: We agreed the ground rules include no laptops during the roundtable.
我们约定的会议规则包括圆桌讨论时不用笔记本电脑。
parking-lot item: The uniform question became a parking-lot item with no time left.
时间不够，工装问题成了一条暂记事项。
decision log: Write the agreed visiting hours into the decision log today.
今天把商定的探视时间写进决策记录。

岗位一变，就更新 RACI（权责矩阵）表。
responsible: The ward clerk is responsible for the accuracy of the census.
在院人数是否准确，由病区文员负责核对。
accountable: The team lead is accountable for the final holiday roster.
最终的假期排班表由组长负总责。
consulted: Pharmacy remains consulted on every change to delivery times.
配送时间每改一次，都会征询药剂科。
informed: The night shift is informed of bed changes through the evening report.
床位一有变化，夜班就会从晚交班里得知。
due date: The due date on the corrective action is the fifteenth.
这项纠正措施的到期日是十五号。
extension: An extension of one week is reasonable if the vendor is late.
如果供应商迟到，延期一周是合理的。
overdue: The vendor invoice is overdue, and Finance has asked twice.
供应商发票已逾期，财务已经催了两次。
pending: My reimbursement is pending until Finance checks the receipts.
报销还待处理，要等财务核对收据。
complete: Please complete the orientation checklist before you work alone.
独立上岗前，请先完成入职介绍的核对清单。
assign: Assign a timekeeper at the start so the briefing ends on time.
开始时就指派计时员，简报才能按时结束。
reassign: We can reassign the visitor to another escort if you are in clinic.
如果你在门诊，我们可以把这位访客改派给另一位陪同。
reopen: Reopen the complaint if the same problem happens again this week.
如果同样的问题这周再发生，就把投诉重新打开。
bottom line: The bottom line is that we need another clerk at Monday registration.
关键结论是，周一挂号处还得再加一名文员。
heads-up: Thanks for the heads-up about the surveyors arriving early.
谢谢你事先提醒评审员会提早到。
green light: We have the green light to recruit the weekend clerk.
周末文员的招聘已经拿到放行批准。
red flag: An unsigned consent form is a red flag during any inspection.
检查时，没签字的知情同意书就是一个警示信号。
gray area: Whether a meal break counts as overtime is still a gray area.
用餐休息算不算加班，仍是一片模糊地带。
chain of command: Follow the chain of command before you write to the director directly.
直接给主任写信之前，先走汇报链条。
org chart: The org chart in the lobby is missing two new team leads.
大厅里的组织架构图漏了两位新组长。
job description: The job description should mention weekend cover and the duty log.
岗位说明书里应写上周末顶班和值班日志。
duty roster: The duty roster for the holiday is on the nurse station wall.
假期值班表贴在护士站的墙上。
on-call: An on-call supervisor must be reachable after the clinic closes.
门诊结束后，必须有一位值班待命的主管能联系上。
standby: Two clerks remain on standby until the evening admissions slow down.
两名文员待命，直到傍晚入院高峰过去。
night shift: The night shift prefers a short written note to a long phone call.
夜班更希望要一张短的书面说明，而不是一通长电话。
day shift: The day shift hands over the open complaints at seven-thirty.
白班在七点半交接还没了结的投诉。
weekend cover: Weekend cover includes the switchboard, the front door, and visitor passes.
周末顶班包括总机、前门和访客证。
leave request: Put the leave request in before the roster for that week is published.
请在那周排班表公布之前提交请假申请。
sick leave: She is on sick leave, so her buddy will cover the desk today.
她在休病假，今天由带教搭档顶这个台。
annual leave: I am saving annual leave for the week my parents visit.
我把年假留到父母来的那一周。
compensatory leave: He took compensatory leave on Monday for working Sunday.
他周日上了班，周一用调休补上。
public holiday: Clinics are closed on the public holiday, but the wards stay open.
公共假期门诊停诊，病区照常。
time off: She asked for time off on the afternoon of the school concert.
她申请学校音乐会那天下午的休假时间。
flex time: Flex time lets him start at seven and finish at three.
弹性工时让他可以七点上班、三点下班。
core hours: During core hours, the information desk must be staffed.
核心工时内，问询台必须有人。
overtime pay: Overtime pay for a public holiday is higher than for a normal Sunday.
公共假期的加班费高于普通周日。
meal break: Take your meal break before the afternoon clinics become busy.
请在下午门诊忙起来之前，先去用餐休息。
handover note: The handover note should say who is waiting for transport home.
交接说明要写明谁还在等车回家。
duty log: Record the power cut in the duty log with the time it started.
请在值班日志里记下停电，并写上开始时间。
secondment: Her secondment to Quality lasts until the end of the survey.
她借调到质量部门，直到这次现场评审结束。
rotation: A rotation through reception helps new clerks learn the building.
在接待处轮岗能帮新文员熟悉这栋楼。
intern: The intern can draft the newsletter, but should not send it.
实习生可以起草简讯，但不应自己发出去。
mentor: Your mentor will introduce you at the first team meeting.
导师会在第一次小组会上介绍你。
buddy: Sit with your buddy for the first morning before you take the desk.
独立上岗前，第一个上午先坐在带教搭档旁边。
orientation: Orientation on day one includes a tour and the fire exits.
第一天的入职介绍包括走一圈和消防出口。
induction: Induction covers privacy, the roster, and how to call security.
入职培训包括保密、排班表，以及怎么叫保卫。
training plan: The training plan for new clerks spreads induction over two weeks.
新文员的培训计划把入职培训摊在两周里。
refresher: A refresher on complaint handling is booked for the experienced clerks.
给有经验的文员约了一场投诉处理的复习培训。
certificate: File a copy of the certificate and keep the original with the person.
证书复印件归入档案，原件留给本人。
license: Check that the license is in date before the visiting doctor starts.
客座医生上岗前，先核对照执照是否在有效期内。
credential: The credential for the agency nurse arrived by email this morning.
派遣护士的资质证明今天早上通过邮件到了。
badge: Return your badge to security on your last working day.
最后一个工作日请把工牌交还保卫科。
access card: Report a lost access card straight away so it can be blocked.
门禁卡丢了要马上报告，以便及时停用。
visitor pass: A visitor pass must be worn and handed back at the lobby desk.
访客证必须佩戴，并在大厅服务台交还。
escort: Children visiting alone still need an escort to the ward.
独自来的儿童探视，仍需要陪同送到病区。
lobby: Please wait in the lobby until someone comes down to collect you.
请在大厅等候，直到有人下来接你。
conference room: The conference room screen is faulty, so bring paper copies.
会议室的屏幕有故障，请带纸质材料。
huddle room: The huddle room fits six people and has no space for a flipchart.
小讨论室坐得下六个人，放不下挂纸板。
training room: The training room is cold, so warn people to bring a jacket.
培训室偏冷，提醒大家带一件外套。
front desk: The front desk keeps a list of wards that are closed to visitors.
前台留着一份暂不接待探视的病区名单。
mailroom: Large parcels should go to the mailroom, not the front desk.
大件包裹送收发室，不要放在前台。
stationery: Order stationery on Thursdays so it arrives the following week.
文具请在周四申领，下一周才能到。
letterhead: Do not use letterhead for draft notes inside the department.
科室内部的草稿便条不要用公文抬头纸。
stamp: The official stamp stays in the safe when the office is empty.
办公室没人时，公章放在保险柜里。
seal: The department seal goes on the certificate copy, beside the signature.
证书副本要在签名旁边加盖部门印章。
watermark: A watermark that says draft should be removed before the final copy.
写着“草稿”的水印，要在终稿之前去掉。
binder: The red binder holds this year's signed policies.
红色文件夹里是今年已签字的制度。
filing: Filing should be done weekly, or the pile hides missing forms.
归档装订要每周做，不然纸堆会把缺的表格盖住。
folder: The folder named ward clerks holds the current guidelines.
名为病区文员的文件夹目录里放着现行指引。
version: Which version of the pathway is posted at the nurse station?
护士站贴的是这份路径的哪个版本？
final copy: Print the final copy on letterhead after the watermark is gone.
水印去掉之后，再用公文抬头纸打印终稿。
tracked changes: Please leave tracked changes visible until the director has read them.
在主任看完之前，请让修订痕迹保持可见。
comment: Her comment asks whether the appendix is still needed.
她的批注问附录是否还需要保留。
footnote: The footnote cites the policy that sets the retention period.
脚注引用了规定保存期限的那份制度。
header: The header on internal memos can be smaller than on outward letters.
内部备忘的页眉可以比外发公函的页眉小。
footer: The footer should include the classification, such as internal only.
页脚应写上密级，例如仅限内部。
page number: Start the page number at one after the cover sheet.
封面之后，页码从 1 开始。
distribution list: Take people who have left the hospital off the distribution list.
请把已经离开医院的人从分发名单里去掉。
mailing list: The clinical mailing list should not be used for social events.
临床邮件名单不应用于聚会通知。
contact list: The contact list for on-call managers is in the duty folder.
值班待命经理的联系人名单在值班文件夹里。
org directory: The org directory still lists her under the old department.
通讯录里她还挂在原来的科室下面。
extension number: If you change desks, tell the switchboard your new extension number.
换了工位，请把新分机号告诉总机。
switchboard: The switchboard is busiest just after the clinics finish.
门诊一结束，总机就最忙。
voicemail: Her voicemail says she is in a meeting until three.
她的语音留言说她开会到三点。
callback: I promised the son a callback once the doctor finished the round.
我答应她儿子，医生查完房就给他回拨。
admission: Her admission was brought forward because the pain increased.
因为疼痛加重，她的入院提前了。
discharge: Discharge before noon frees the bed for the emergency list.
中午以前出院，才能把床腾给急诊。
transfer: The transfer to Rehabilitation is planned for tomorrow morning.
转到康复科的安排定在明天上午。
referral: This referral asks Cardiology to see the patient within a week.
这张转诊单要求心内科一周内接诊该患者。
appointment: I moved her appointment to Thursday so she can bring the films.
我把她的预约改到周四，方便她把片子带来。
registration: Registration asked the clinic to send patients down in smaller groups.
挂号登记处请门诊把患者分小批送下来。
reception: Reception greeted the accreditation visitors and checked their names.
接待处迎接了评审来宾，并核对了姓名。
waiting list: He has been on the waiting list for an elective bed since March.
他从三月起就在择期床位的等候名单上。
queue: The queue outside Registration stretched into the lobby.
挂号处门外的队伍一直排到了大厅。
census: Tonight's census is one hundred and forty patients.
今晚的在院人数是一百四十名患者。
occupancy: Occupancy on the medical ward is high, so elective cases may wait.
内科病区的床位占用率很高，择期病例可能还要再等。
bed management: Bed management wants the discharge predictions before two o'clock.
床位管理希望两点前拿到预计出院名单。
ward round: Please have the notes ready before the ward round reaches bed six.
查房走到六床之前，请把记录准备好。
clinic: The fracture clinic asked for a quieter waiting space.
骨折门诊希望有一处更安静的等候区。
outpatient: The outpatient waited an hour because the slip was misfiled.
这位门诊患者等了一小时，因为单据归错了档。
inpatient: The inpatient in bed four is listed for discharge today.
四床的住院患者今天列入了出院名单。
elective: The elective admission was moved to make room for an emergency.
这次择期入院被调整了，以便给急诊腾床。
consent form: A consent form without a date will be sent back by the checker.
没有日期的知情同意书会被检查人退回。
insurance: Please confirm the insurance plan before the elective admission.
择期入院之前，请先确认医保保险方案。
copay: Patients pay the copay at the cashier before they see the doctor.
患者见医生之前，先在收费处交自付费用。
billing: Billing queried a charge that belonged to another visit.
计费收费部门质疑了一笔属于另一次就诊的费用。
claim: Her claim for the train fare is waiting on a receipt.
她的火车票报销申请还在等收据。
encounter: Yesterday's encounter has no clinician name on the printout.
昨天的就诊记录打印出来后没有医生姓名。
visit: This visit was only for a blood test and a prescription.
这次就诊只是抽血和开药。
no-show: We had one no-show in the diabetes clinic this morning.
今天上午糖尿病门诊有一位爽约未到。
triage desk: The triage desk needs a second clerk from ten until noon.
分诊台从十点到中午需要第二名文员。
nurse station: Leave the discharge papers at the nurse station rather than at reception.
出院材料放在护士站，不要放在接待处。
information desk: The information desk keeps paper maps for the new wing.
问询台备有新病房楼的纸质地图。
duty: Listing visitor passes is part of your duty this week.
本周登记访客证是你的值班职责之一。
assignment: Your assignment today is the lobby desk until two.
你今天的任务分配是两点前守大厅服务台。
department head: The department head asked for the complaint summary before lunch.
科室主任要求午饭前拿到投诉摘要。
director: The director drops by the information desk once a week unannounced.
主任每周会不打招呼地到问询台看看。
secretary: The secretary keeps the director's calendar and the spare stamp.
秘书保管主任的日历和备用公章。
clerk: A clerk from the night desk will help with the morning queue.
夜班台的一位文员会来帮忙疏导早高峰排队。
coordinator: The coordinator moved two elective cases to balance the wards.
协调员调整了两台择期手术，好让各病区床位均衡。
liaison: Our liaison will meet the bureau visitors at the main door.
我们的联络人会在大门迎接卫健委来宾。
counterpart: I asked my counterpart in Radiology to check the referral date.
我请放射科的对口同事核对转诊日期。
colleague: A colleague in Finance explained why the invoice was rejected.
财务的一位同事解释了这张发票被退回的原因。
supervisor: Tell your supervisor before you agree to cover an extra shift.
答应多顶一个班次之前，先告诉上级主管。
manager: The manager wants the overtime figures before the quarterly review.
经理希望在季度回顾之前拿到加班数据。
team lead: The team lead will run the briefing if the supervisor is in clinic.
如果主管在门诊，简报就由组长来主持。
staff: Staff who finish after nine may request a taxi voucher.
九点以后下班的员工可以申请出租车凭证。
workforce: The winter workforce plan adds cover for sick leave and holidays.
冬季人力计划增加了病假和假期的顶班。
shift handover: Shift handover is at the nurse station, not in the corridor.
交接班在护士站进行，不要在走廊里。
morning huddle: The morning huddle is standing only and lasts fifteen minutes.
晨会全程站着，只开十五分钟。
evening report: Please stay for the evening report if your patient is unstable.
如果你的患者病情不稳，请留下参加晚交班。
board round: At the board round we decide who can go home today.
看板交班时我们决定今天谁可以回家。
bed meeting: The bed meeting wants discharge predictions, not just the census.
床位会要的是预计出院情况，不只是在院人数。
ops meeting: The ops meeting this week will focus on the registration queue.
这周的运营会重点看挂号排队。
quality meeting: The quality meeting asked each ward for one lesson learned.
质量会要求每个病区交一条经验教训。
safety huddle: Yesterday's safety huddle covered a missing patient label.
昨天的安全短会谈了一例患者标签缺失。
incident report: File the incident report before you go off shift, while you remember.
下班前趁还记得，把不良事件报告写好。
near miss: That near miss happened because two labels looked almost the same.
那起未遂事件是因为两张标签看起来几乎一样。
root cause: The root cause was a roster change that nobody passed on.
根本原因是排班改了，却没有人传达下去。
corrective action: The corrective action is a read-back of the patient name at handover.
纠正措施是交接时把患者姓名复述一遍。
preventive action: The preventive action is to separate look-alike drugs on the shelf.
预防措施是把看起来相似的药品在架子上分开。
lesson learned: The lesson learned is to check the room number on the invitation.
经验教训是要核对邀请上的房间号。
best practice: A best practice we copied is naming a deputy before every leave.
我们学来的一条最佳实践是，每次休假前都指定代理人。
standard: The standard calls for two identifiers before a blood sample.
标准要求抽血前核对两种身份标识。
protocol: The protocol says a near miss must be written up the same day.
规程规定，未遂事件必须在当天写成书面材料。
pathway: The new stroke pathway starts at the triage desk.
新的卒中路径从分诊台开始。
checklist audit: The checklist audit sampled twenty consent forms on the surgical ward.
清单抽查在外科病区抽了二十份知情同意书。
spot check: A spot check at lunch found the stamp left on the counter.
午餐时的突击检查发现公章留在了台面上。
walkthrough: The walkthrough will follow a visitor from the lobby to the ward.
现场走查会跟着一位访客从大厅走到病区。
inspection: The linen inspection is on Tuesday, so the carts should be tidy.
布草检查在周二，所以布草车要收拾整齐。
finding: The main finding was a fridge temperature that nobody had signed.
主要检查发现是冰箱温度没有人签字。
nonconformity: That nonconformity must be closed before the surveyors return.
评审员回来之前，那项不符合项必须关闭。
CAPA: The CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) for the patient fall is due in May.
这起患者跌倒的 CAPA（纠正预防措施）五月到期。
accreditation: We are preparing documents for accreditation in the spring.
我们正在为春天的评审认证准备材料。
survey: During the survey, reviewers will follow one patient through Radiology.
现场评审期间，评审员会跟着一名患者走一遍放射科。
tracer: The tracer started at admission and ended at the pharmacy window.
这次追踪检查从入院开始，到药房窗口结束。
mock survey: The mock survey will spend a morning on the surgical ward.
模拟评审会在外科病区待一个上午。
scorecard: Our scorecard improved after we shortened the registration queue.
挂号排队缩短之后，计分卡有了改善。
dashboard review: Monday's dashboard review will focus on waiting time.
周一的看板回顾会聚焦等候时间。
target: Our target for answering the main phone is three rings.
总机电话的目标是三声之内接起。
baseline: Use last January as the baseline when you describe waiting times.
描述等候时间时，请用去年一月作为基线。
trend: The trend in complaints has been downward for three months.
投诉趋势已经连续三个月下降。
variance: A large variance in overtime needs an explanation for Finance.
加班偏差很大，需要给财务一个说明。
actuals: March actuals show we spent less on courier fees than planned.
三月的实际数显示，快递费花得比计划少。
forecast: The forecast for flu season adds beds on the medical ward.
流感季的预测是内科病区要加床。
budget: The stationery budget is almost gone for this quarter.
这个季度的文具预算快用完了。
cost center: Taxi vouchers should be charged to the administration cost center.
出租车凭证应记到行政成本中心。
purchase order: No delivery will start without a purchase order from procurement.
没有采购部门的采购订单，送货不会开始。
requisition: I raised a requisition for thirty visitor passes this morning.
我今天早上开了三十张访客证的请购单。
quote: Could you chase the quote for the replacement lockers?
你能去追一下更换储物柜的询价报价吗？
lead time: Ask the vendor what the lead time is for printed letterhead.
问问供应商，印公文抬头纸的供货周期是多久。
stock: Check the stock of consent forms before the Monday clinics.
周一门诊开始前，先看一下知情同意书的库存。
inventory: The inventory of access cards is scheduled for the first Friday.
门禁卡盘点库存安排在第一个周五。
shortage: A shortage of porters delayed two discharges this morning.
运送人员短缺，今天上午耽误了两名患者出院。
surplus: The surplus binders from last year can supply the new clerks.
去年多余的文件夹可以发给新来的文员。
consumable: Paper for the ward printers is ordered as a consumable.
病区打印机的纸是按耗材来申领的。
asset: Each laptop in the training room is recorded as an asset.
培训室里的每台笔记本电脑都登记为资产。
label: The label on the archive box should show the year and the ward.
档案箱上的标签应写明年份和病区。
serial number: Write the serial number in the log when you lend a laptop.
借出笔记本电脑时，把序列号写进登记本。
asset tag: If the asset tag is missing, ask Finance for a replacement.
资产标签如果掉了，请财务补一张。
depreciation: Finance calculates depreciation on ward equipment once a year.
财务每年计算一次病区设备的折旧。
write-off: A cracked tablet may need a write-off if repair costs more.
平板裂了，如果维修更贵，可能需要核销。
petty cash: Use petty cash only when a card payment is not possible.
只有不能刷卡时才动用备用金。
receipt: Keep every receipt until the reimbursement has been paid.
在报销款到账之前，请留好每一张收据。
expense: Parking at the bureau is a reclaimable expense with a receipt.
在卫健委停车，有收据就可以作为费用报销。
travel request: Submit the travel request before you book the train.
订火车票之前，先提交出差申请。
travel claim: The travel claim must list the hotel, the meals, and the train.
差旅报销必须列明酒店、餐费和火车票。
per diem: The per diem covers meals, and it does not cover the hotel.
每日补贴只含餐费，不含住宿。
accommodation: Accommodation for the two-day course is opposite the station.
两天课程的住宿在车站对面。
transport: Public transport is fine, and the bureau is a short walk away.
可以坐公共交通，卫健委步行一会儿就到。
taxi voucher: A taxi voucher is for late finishes, not for ordinary commuting.
出租车凭证用于晚下班，不是日常通勤。
parking permit: Display the parking permit on the dashboard, or security will call.
请把停车许可放在仪表盘上，否则保安会打电话。
canteen: Night staff can use the canteen entrance beside the ambulance bay.
夜班员工可以走救护车站旁边的食堂入口。
locker: Do not leave a visitor pass in an unlocked locker.
不要把访客证放在没锁的储物柜里。
uniform: If your uniform is stained, collect a spare from the linen room.
工装弄脏了，到布草间领一套备用的。
notice board: The fire drill time is written on the staff notice board.
消防演练时间写在员工公告栏上。
suggestion box: The suggestion box by the canteen is emptied every Friday.
食堂旁的意见箱每周五清空一次。
complaint: Please log the complaint with the date, the ward, and the family's name.
请记下投诉的日期、病区和家属姓名。
compliment: The compliment described a clerk who found a lost hearing aid.
这则表扬写的是一位找回助听器的文员。
patient feedback: Patient feedback from April mentions waits and kind reception staff.
四月的患者反馈提到了等候，也提到接待人员态度好。
service recovery: Service recovery included a quieter room and a call from the manager.
服务补救包括一间更安静的房间，以及经理打来的电话。
apology: An apology from the clinic lead calmed the family down.
门诊负责人的道歉让家属平静了下来。
courtesy: A little courtesy at the window can calm a long wait.
窗口上一点礼貌，能让长时间等候好受些。
professionalism: Professionalism means you do not discuss patients in the lift.
职业素养包括不在电梯里谈论患者。
punctuality: Punctuality at the safety huddle keeps it to fifteen minutes.
安全短会准时开始，才能控制在十五分钟。
courtesy copy: I sent the absent chair a courtesy copy of the agenda.
我给缺席的主持人发了一份议程的礼节抄送。
hard copy: The bureau still insists on a hard copy with a live signature.
卫健委仍然要求有亲笔签名的纸质件。
soft copy: A soft copy of the policy is enough for the ward folders.
病区文件夹里放这份制度的电子件就够了。
original: Send the original to Legal and keep a photocopy locally.
把原件送给法务，本地留一份复印件。
duplicate: This duplicate is stamped and is acceptable for the personnel file.
这份副本已盖章，可以放入人事档案。
photocopy: Make a photocopy of the license before you hand back the original.
归还原件之前，先把执照复印一份。
scan: The scan is blurry, so please ask the ward for a clearer page.
扫描件模糊了，请病区再给一页更清楚的。
fax: The fax number on our letterhead changed last month.
公文抬头纸上的传真号码上个月改了。
courier: Book the courier before three if the letter must arrive tomorrow.
如果信必须明天到，请在三点前约好快递。
dispatch: The mailroom will dispatch the sealed bids this afternoon.
收发室今天下午会把密封的投标文件发出去。
receive: The ward clerk must receive the package and sign the slip.
病区文员必须当面签收包裹并在单据上签字。
return: Please return the draft if the figures do not match the census.
如果数字和在院人数对不上，请把草稿退回。
revise: I will revise the outline after I hear the director's comments.
听完主任的意见后，我会修订提纲。
amend: Legal will amend the last clause before we sign.
签字之前，法务会修改最后一条。
finalize: Can we finalize the attendee list by the end of today?
参会人名单今天收工前能定稿吗？
issue: HR will issue the holiday circular on Monday morning.
人力资源部周一上午印发假期传阅文件。
announce: The director will announce the new clinic hours at the town hall.
主任会在全员大会上宣布新的门诊时间。
communicate: Who will communicate the room change to people already traveling?
已经在路上的人，房间变更由谁去沟通？
discuss: We can discuss the intern's rotation at your one-on-one.
实习生的轮岗可以在你的一对一面谈里讨论。
consult: Did anyone consult the night shift before changing the handover time?
改交接时间之前，有没有征询过夜班？
recommend: I recommend a written handover note for every weekend cover.
我建议每次周末顶班都留一份书面交接说明。
suggest: I suggest we start the bed meeting with today's discharges.
我提议床位会先从今天的出院情况谈起。
propose: I propose moving the quality meeting to Wednesday afternoon.
我提出把质量会改到周三下午。
present: She will present the complaint themes at the quality meeting.
她会在质量会上汇报这几类投诉。
report: Please report any lost badge to security the same day.
工牌丢失请在当天向保卫报告。
debrief: We should debrief the spot check while the details are fresh.
突击检查的细节还清楚时，我们就该复盘。
summarize: Could you summarize the board round for the director in five lines?
你能用五行简短的话，给主任总结看板交班吗？
highlight: Highlight the wards that are above ninety percent occupancy.
请标出床位占用率超过百分之九十的病区。
emphasize: The chairperson will emphasize confidentiality before any case is discussed.
讨论具体案例之前，主持人会先强调保密。
compile: Please compile the sick leave figures for the quarterly review.
请为季度回顾汇总病假数字。
distribute: Volunteers will distribute the handout as people enter the hall.
大家进会场时，志愿者会分发会发材料。
notify: Notify the escort desk if a visitor arrives without an appointment.
如果访客没有预约就来了，请通知陪同台。
inform: Inform the family early if the discharge will slip past noon.
如果出院会拖过中午，请早点告知家属。
request: Patients sometimes request a female clerk at the information desk.
患者有时会在问询台申请由女文员接待。
submit: Submit your overtime timesheet before payroll closes on Wednesday.
请在周三工资结算截止前提交加班工时表。
review: Would you review the circular before HR issues it tomorrow?
人力资源部明天印发之前，你能审阅一下这份传阅文件吗？
approve: The sponsor must approve the scope change before we continue.
范围变更必须先由发起人批准，我们才能继续。
reject: The panel may reject a bid that arrives after the deadline.
过了截止日期才到的投标，评审小组可以驳回。
schedule: Can you schedule the induction for the Monday she starts?
你能把入职培训安排在她入职的那个周一吗？
